picks.recommendation: Cobolli's substantial positive edge (78.3% vs 55.3% market) is strongly supported by his elite #7 ranking, which the model heavily favors against a much lower-ranked opponent on hard court, even with his current 'out of form' sentiment. The market might be overreacting to his recent struggles and underestimating his overall hard-court prowess and ranking advantage.
